guitar.modelsText: Fender Jazzmaster / Gibson Les Paul / Gretsch
guitar.notes: Turner has used Jazzmasters, Gibson ES-335/Les Pauls, and various others over the band's career; no single iconic instrument, so medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: riffy Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.profile: riffy Marshall crunch with tight bite
tone.summary: A classic British crunch tone using the UK 45 amp model, boosted by an OD pedal and paired with a vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve bright upper mids and thick low end.

rig.name: Arctic Monkeys - R U Mine_ - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from aggressive riffing.
Provide the necessary lead boost and tighten up the core riff crunch.
Simulate the Tube Screamer/Marshall crunch and provide bright upper mids.
blocks.gap: The catalog lacks a dedicated TS-style pedal, but Green OD is the closest choice for high-gain, mid-focused boost.

alternatives.reason: More general overdrive, less focused on the specific 'crunch' tone needed.

blocks.purpose: Add foundational saturation and thickness to the core riff tone.
blocks.gap: Used here as a secondary drive stage to ensure 'thick low end' while maintaining clarity, mimicking stacked amps.

blocks.purpose: Model the classic Marshall/Plexi sound required for British rock crunch.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary frequency response for the tone.
Sculpt the tone by boosting upper mids and high frequencies for 'bright bite' while controlling low-end mud.
Disabled to avoid 'jangly clean' or lush effects, keeping the tone dry and focused on riffs.
blocks.gap: The module is included but deactivated per musical verdict instructions.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle rhythmic depth to the riffs without sounding overly ambient.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly for texture, avoiding excessive 'lush reverb' or delay tails.

blocks.purpose: Provide minimal natural room ambience without sounding 'lush' or overly wet.
blocks.gap: Kept very low to avoid excessive reverb, fulfilling the requirement for a dry attack while adding slight depth.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR for better realism and punch, focusing on a classic British rock sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and vintage character of the Marshall tone.
